allow_category_change.description:
Set to true to allow to assign a category based on template guidelines and the template's contents.
This can prevent the template status from immediately being set to REJECTED upon creation due to miscategorization.
If omitted, template will not be auto-assigned a category and its status may be set to REJECTED if determined to be miscategorized.

buttons.description: Button components to be used in the template.

text.description:
Component text.
Required for components with type HEADER, BODY or FOOTER.

library_template_button_inputs.description:
Optional data during creation of a template from a library template.
These are optional fields for the button component.

message_send_ttl_seconds.description:
Time to live for message template sent.
If users are offline for more than TTL duration after message template is sent, we will retry the delivery for a period of time known as a time-to-live, TTL, or the message validity period.
TTL can be configured for certain message types.

message_send_ttl_seconds.description:
Template message delivery retry time-to-live (TTL) override value.
If we are unable to deliver a message to a WhatsApp user, we will retry the delivery for a period of time known as a time-to-live, TTL, or the message validity period.
TTL can be configured for certain message types.
